title: Iron-Rich Foods for Anemia Prevention
body: Include spinach, lentils, jaggery, and sesame seeds in your daily diet. These are locally available in Nabha markets and help prevent iron deficiency.

title: Hand Washing Saves Lives
body: Wash hands with soap for at least 20 seconds before meals and after using the toilet. This simple habit prevents 80% of infectious diseases.

title: Prenatal Check-ups Are Essential
body: Pregnant women should visit PHC at least 4 times during pregnancy. Free check-ups and medicines are available at all Nabha PHCs under Janani Suraksha Yojana.

title: Control Blood Sugar Naturally
body: Walk for 30 minutes daily, reduce white rice and refined sugar intake. Regular blood sugar checks at PHC are free under NPCDCS programme.

title: Complete Your Child's Vaccination
body: Ensure your child receives all vaccines as per the immunisation schedule. Free vaccines are available at all PHCs in Nabha. Missed vaccines can lead to serious diseases.
